task_completion.description: Add the CelesTrak GNSS TLE data source to GPredict preferences.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Preferences -> TLE Update -> Sources dialog, the URL 'https://celestrak.org/NORAD/elements/gnss.txt' is added to the list of TLE sources.

task_completion.description: Update the satellite database from the network.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A progress bar or dialog showing 'Updating TLE data' or a 'TLE update finished' notification/log entry.

task_completion.description: Create the 'NIST_Boulder' ground station with specific coordinates and altitude.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Ground Stations configuration dialog shows a station named 'NIST_Boulder' with Latitude: 39.9936 N, Longitude: 105.2618 W (or -105.2618), and Altitude: 1655 m.

task_completion.description: Set 'NIST_Boulder' as the default ground station.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the GPredict preferences or ground station list, 'NIST_Boulder' is marked as the default (often indicated by a checkmark or selection in the General preferences).

task_completion.description: Set the application to display time in UTC.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In Preferences -> Interface -> Time, the 'Display time in UTC' option is selected, or the main clock in the GPredict status bar shows 'UTC'.

task_completion.description: Create a new module named 'GNSS_Timing' with the four specified satellites.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new module window or tab titled 'GNSS_Timing' is visible, containing the satellites NAVSTAR 82 (55268), NAVSTAR 81 (48859), GALILEO 22 (43058), and GALILEO 26 (43565).

integrity.description: The agent used the GPredict GUI to configure settings rather than editing config files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with GPredict menus, preference dialogs, and module creation wizards.

integrity.description: The agent actually triggered a TLE update rather than just naming a module.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Update TLE' dialog or log messages showing network activity to celestrak.org.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the NIST coordinates into the ground station dialog.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the Ground Station editor with the specific values 39.9936, -105.2618, and 1655 typed into the fields.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The TLE URL must be exactly https://celestrak.org/NORAD/elements/gnss.txt. The ground station 'NIST_Boulder' must have Latitude 39.9936 N, Longitude 105.2618 W, and Altitude 1655. The module 'GNSS_Timing' must contain exactly four satellites with NORAD IDs: 55268, 48859, 43058, and 43565. Time display must be set to UTC.
